_format: each turn: [speaker, text, needs_answer, expected_doc_title_or_null, expected_verdict_or_null]

calls.name: Acme Health negotiation
turns: Hey Dana, good to see you again. Can you hear me okay?
Yep, loud and clear. Sorry, I'm a couple of minutes late, back-to-back meetings today.
No worries at all. How was the conference last week?
Honestly exhausting, but good. Lots of talk about AI, as you'd expect.
Ha, I bet. So last time we left off with the Enterprise proposal. Where did your team land?
Thanks for making time. We've reviewed the Enterprise proposal.
Can you do 20% off if we sign for 3 years?
We can do 15% with a three-year commitment, and that's approved today.
We're in healthcare. Do you sign a HIPAA BAA?
Yes, the BAA is included in your Enterprise plan.
Great. We need net-60 payment terms.
Net 60 works for a deal this size.
Can you raise the liability cap to 3x fees?
Let me check with our Legal team and get back to you on the cap.
Sounds good. Send over the paperwork when you can.
Will do. Have a great rest of your week!

calls.name: Retail discovery call
turns: Hi Marcus, thanks for jumping on. How's your morning going?
Good, good. Busy. We're in the middle of holiday planning, so it's a bit chaotic.
I can imagine. Is it snowing over there yet?
Not yet, thankfully. Give it two weeks.
So tell me a little about how your team does reporting today.
Right now it's a mess of spreadsheets and an old BI tool nobody likes.
All our data lives in Snowflake and Shopify. Do you connect to those?
Snowflake for sure, it's one of our native connectors.
We'd have about 80 people building dashboards. How does pricing work for that?
Viewers are free, so it's really about the creators.
Got it. And what about the AI stuff? Is our data used to train your models?
Our security team is going to send over a big questionnaire. Can you fill that out?
Absolutely, we have most of it pre-filled.
Honestly though, we don't have budget until next quarter.
That's fair. What changes for you next quarter?
New fiscal year. The CFO frees up the innovation budget.
Could we do some kind of free trial in the meantime?
Let me see what we can do there.
Cool. Alright, I've got to jump to another call, thanks!

calls.name: Fintech negotiation
turns: Hi! Sorry, my camera's being weird today.
No problem at all. Did you get a chance to look at the proposal?
I did. Honestly, it's more expensive than we expected.
Understood. What were you comparing it against?
We have a quote from a competitor that's about thirty percent lower.
Would you be open to sharing it so we can compare like-for-like?
Maybe. If we went with you, could you waive the implementation fee?
And we'd want renewal increases capped at three percent.
Those are reasonable asks, let me walk through what's possible.
We also can't start until March. Could the start date be ninety days out?
Contract Terms and Renewals|Objection: Timing and Budget
Our CFO and legal team will need to sign off on all of this.
Makes sense. Should we set up a call with them next week?
That works. Also, procurement will need a W-9 and your insurance certificate.
One more thing, if we leave, do we get our data back and do you delete it?
Yes, you own your data. I'll send the details in writing.
Perfect, thanks so much. Talk next week.

calls.name: Rapport-heavy check-in
turns: Priya! How was the trip to Lisbon?
Oh it was amazing. The food, the weather, everything. I didn't want to come back.
I'm so jealous. Did you get to Sintra?
We did, the kids loved the castle. My son is now obsessed with knights.
That's adorable. Okay, I know you only have twenty minutes, so let's dive in.
Yeah, let's do it. So the team's been asking how big you guys actually are.
Also, what happens if your service goes down in the middle of the night?
And do you have other healthcare customers we could talk to?
We do, I can set up a reference call.
Is single-tenant on your roadmap? Our architects keep asking.
It's planned, but I can't commit to dates.
Totally fair. Did you watch the game last night by the way?
Unbelievable. Okay, I'll let you go. Thanks!
